sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Kilthane: The Black Knight''' is a well-rounded [[Titan]] with good ATK and DEF which make him a good friend to have. Because of his strength, [[Seekers]] tend to use him early, but he's strongest when used later when he can be called to the side of heroes further in the mission.
